function.name: search_calendar_events
function.description: Searches calendar events that match the given query in the title or the description. If provided, filters events by date.

query.description: The query string to search for in event titles and descriptions.

date.description: The date for which to search events. Must be in format YYYY-MM-DD. If null, searches all events.

function.name: delete_file
function.description: Delete a file from the cloud drive by its filename. It returns the file that was deleted.

file_id.description: The name of the file to delete.
